title: scheduled-batch-jobs-events.html
content: You can see our scheduled jobs in Setup > Jobs > Scheduled Jobs. All of the names start with Blackthorn | Events. {{snippet.Events_ChangeScheduledApexUser}} Scheduled Jobs Blackthorn | Events Process No-Show Attendees Runs nightly at 11:00 pm. Updates an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendancStatus}} to "No-Show" if the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} has passed, and the {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendancStatus}} is NOT "Attended." This feature can be enabled/disabled using Event Settings' {{variable.Field_ETSettings_AutoUpdNoShow}} field. Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Blackthorn | Events Attendee Parent Rollup Runs nightly at 2:00 am. Looks for {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records that are linked to a Contact or Lead record and have the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} set to “Attended.” For each {{variable.Object_Contact}} or {{variable.Object_Lead}} with at least one {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record with the criteria described above, the scheduled job will count the number of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s each {{variable.Object_Contact}} or {{variable.Object_Lead}} record has. The {{variable.Field_Contact_EventsAttended}} field on the {{variable.Object_Contact}} or {{variable.Object_Lead}} record will then be updated with the new number. While the job will always check all records meeting these criteria, it will only update the {{variable.Field_Contact_EventsAttended}} count when the number differs from the previous run. The {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button schedules the AttendeeRollupToParent batch and sets the chunk size to 50,000 records. If you need to decrease the chunk size, use the Schedule Attendee Parent Rollup Job button. Blackthorn | Events Form Submission Processing Runs at the top of each hour (12:00, 1:00, 2:00, etc.) and every five minutes. Processes {{variable.Object_FormSubmissionAnswer}} s and links them to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} , {{variable.Object_Contact}} , {{variable.Object_Account}} , or {{variable.Object_Lead}} based on the {{variable.Object_FormElement}} s’ mapping requirements. Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Use the Process Form Submissions button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Batch Jobs tab to run the FormSubmissionProcessAnswerBatch batch job every five minutes. This job will process all unprocessed submissions. Blackthorn | Events Geocode Service Runs nightly at 10:00 pm. Updates the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueAddrGeocode}} field on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record based on the Venue’s provided address. Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Blackthorn | Event Webinar Account Refresh Apex Class Job: WebinarAccountAuthRefresh Runs daily at 2:00 am. Ensures the webinar account refresh token does not expire. Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Blackthorn | Events Recurring Event Generate Runs nightly at 3:00 am. Updates and creates {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s when {{variable.Field_RecEvents_RecurrenceMeth}} = "Keep One Open" or "Auto-Renew." Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Blackthorn | Events Status Update Runs nightly at 1:00 am. If there are more than 1,500 active {{variable.Object_Event}} s, this job updates any {{variable.Object_Event}} where the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} is in the past. It unpublishes the {{variable.Object_Event}} and updates the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} to "Completed." Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Blackthorn | Events Registration Processing Runs every minute. Since this job processes Event Registration Submission (ERS) records in batches, there may be a delay of up to one minute before a record is processed. Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Apex Class: EventRegistrationBatchProcess Blackthorn | Events Revenue Rollups Once an {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} = “Ended,” the job will run, rolling up Event Item and {{variable.Object_Event}} financial summaries. Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Blackthorn | Events Cache Refresh This job schedules a cache refresh to run periodically and will refresh the cache to avoid any front-end caching issues. Use the {{variable.Button_ScheduEventCacheRefresh}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Scheduled Jobs tab. Create Webinars for Events Use this job to create webinars for {{variable.Object_Event}} s with a value in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} field and no value in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} field. Use the {{variable.Button_CreateWebinarsEvents}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Batch Jobs tab. Create Webinars for Sessions Use this job to create webinars for {{variable.Object_Session}} s with a value in the {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMeetiAcct}} field and no value in the {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMtgURL}} field. Use the {{variable.Button_CreateWebinarsSessions}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Batch Jobs tab. Blackthorn | Events Attendee Webinar Registration Register your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s with your webinar provider so your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s receive a personalized URL to join the webinar. Use the {{variable.Button_RegisterAttendeeWebinar}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin's Batch Jobs tab. Criteria that will trigger the job based on object type. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s The {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebiMeetJoinURL}} field is blank. The {{variable.Field_Attendee_WebRegistFailed}} checkbox is checked. The {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} field is set to “Registered.” The {{variable.Field_Attendee_Event}} field is blank. The Attendee’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_Event}} and the Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} fields are blank. The Attendee’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_Event}} and the Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} fields are blank. The Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} is set to today. {{variable.Object_SessionAttendee}} s The {{variable.Field_SessionAtten_WebMJoinURL}} field is blank. The {{variable.Field_SessionAtten_WebRegiFail}} checkbox is checked. The {{variable.Field_SessionAtten_RegisStatus}} field is set to “Registered.” The Session Attendee’s {{variable.Field_SessionAtten_Attendee}} and Attendee’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_Event}} fields are blank. The Session’s {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMeetiAcct}} is blank. The Session’s {{variable.Field_Session_WebinarMeetingID}} field is blank. The Session’s {{variable.Field_Session_EndDate}} is set to today. Blackthorn | Base Adv Visibility Hourly Sync Apex Class: FilterRecordsSyncBatch Runs once an hour. To activate this scheduled job, set the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} ’s {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field to "True" (checked) and the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field to the current date and time. Going forward, when a user creates or updates a {{variable.Object_BTRule}} or {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} record, the job will check the date/time in the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field, looking for records with a {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} after the scheduled job's start date/time. If the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} is before the scheduled job's start date, the {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field will be set to "False." NOTE: Setting {{variable.Object_BTRule}} {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} = "True" (checked) will not cause the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} to be processed immediately. It will be processed during the next scheduled run. {{snippet.ScheduledJob_TimeZoneFAQ}} Delete a Scheduled Job If you need to unschedule a scheduled job, complete the following steps. Go to the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab. Click the Scheduled Jobs tab. Locate the button related to the scheduled job. Click the button for the job you want to disable. Do not delete the scheduled job by going to Setup > Scheduled Jobs. If you do, the jobs will still appear in the Scheduled Jobs tab as scheduled.
